fields.title: 📖 Bad character spoils deeds
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Bad character spoils the deed, just as vinegar spoils honey.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Akhlāq** is not a side matter. Whoever wants to preserve his deeds must also preserve his **character** – for ***bad character*** can destroy the worth of good deeds.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Albānī, as-Silsilah aṣ-Ṣaḥīḥah, Hadith Nr. 906; überliefert von ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar.
